rules.statement: Section 2 of Ordinance No. 9 of 1841 excludes the application of section 8 of Ordinance No. 12 of 1840 to any land referred to in section 6, which are lands derived by parties or their predecessors from forest, chena, waste, or uncultivated lands of the Crown.
rules.supporting_quote: "I would hold that the effect of section 2 of Ordinance No. 9 of 1841 is to exclude the application of section 8 of Ordinance No. 12 of 1840 to any land referred to in section 6 of that Ordinance."
